from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'));import cad,check_timing
out=root/'build/ulx3s-static';design=root/'build/ulx3s/design.json'
inputs=json.loads((root/'build/ulx3s/build-inputs.json').read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
extra={'build/ulx3s/design.json':sha(design),'build/ulx3s/build-inputs.json':sha(root/'build/ulx3s/build-inputs.json'),'build/ulx3s-static/run.py':sha(Path(__file__))}
for name,digest in inputs['inputs'].items():assert sha(root/name)==digest,name
args=['--85k','--package','CABGA381','--speed','6','--seed','1','--router','router2','--json',str(design),'--lpf',str(root/'fpga/ulx3s.lpf'),'--textcfg',str(out/'design.config'),'--report',str(out/'timing.json'),'--write',str(out/'routed.json'),'--freq','25']
(out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(args,indent=2)+'\n')
place_args=args.copy()
for key in ['--textcfg','--report']:
 i=place_args.index(key);del place_args[i:i+2]
place_args[place_args.index('--write')+1]=str(out/'placed.json')
place_args+=['--no-route','--placer','static']
with (out/'placement.log').open('w') as f:subprocess.run(cad.command('nextpnr-ecp5')+place_args,env=cad.environment(),stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
extra['build/ulx3s-static/placed.json']=sha(out/'placed.json')
args[args.index('--json')+1]=str(out/'placed.json');args+=['--no-pack','--no-place']
(out/'commands.json').write_text(json.dumps({'placement':place_args,'routing':args},indent=2)+'\n')
with (out/'nextpnr.log').open('w') as f:subprocess.run(cad.command('nextpnr-ecp5')+args,env=cad.environment(),stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
audit=check_timing.audit(out/'timing.json');(out/'timing-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(audit,indent=2)+'\n')
for name,digest in {**inputs['inputs'],**extra}.items():assert sha(root/name)==digest,name
routed=json.loads((out/'routed.json').read_text())
assert any(m.get('attributes',{}).get('wasmetal_input_sha256')==inputs['fingerprint'] for m in routed['modules'].values())
with (out/'ecppack.log').open('w') as f:subprocess.run(cad.command('ecppack')+[str(out/'design.config'),str(out/'wasmetal.bit'),'--compress'],env=cad.environment(),stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
(out/'trial-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'inputs':inputs,'extra_inputs':extra,'command':args,'timing':audit,'artifacts':{p.name:sha(p) for p in [out/'design.config',out/'routed.json',out/'timing.json',out/'wasmetal.bit']},'physical_hardware_tested':False},indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS routed and packed static placement design',flush=True)
